LPL/2026/Split 2.format:
* '''Regular Season''' ** Teams are split into 2 groups based on [[LPL/2026/Split 1|Split 1]] performance *** Top 8 teams from Split 1 are placed into Group Ascend *** Next 6 teams are placed into Group Nirvana ** Teams will play a Round Robin within their Groups *** Group Ascend will play a ''Double'' Round Robin *** Group Nirvana will play a ''Single'' Round Robin *** All matches will be {{Abbr/Bo3}} with {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}} ** In Group Ascend: *** Top 4 advance to Knockout Stage *** Next 4 advance to Knights Rivals ** In Group Nirvana: *** Top 4 advance to Knights Rivals *** Bottom 2 will end their 2026 LPL season immediately ** Tiebreakers: **# Series Wins **# Game Difference **# Head-to-Head Series Wins **# Head-to-Head Game Difference **# {{Abbr/Bo3}} Tiebreaker Match, if it affects the team's advancement, seeding in Knights Rivals, or seeding in Knockout Stage * '''Knights Rivals''' ** Teams will play a Single {{Abbr/Bo5}} with {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}} based on Regular Season placements ** 4 winners advance to Knockout Stage * '''Knockout Stage''' ** Double Elimination *** In order of position in Group Ascend, the 4 directly qualified teams will pick their opponents for Upper Bracket Quarterfinals *** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} with {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}} * ''Click here for detailed information about First Selection''
* '''Regular Season First Selection''' ** During the first meeting between two teams, Game 1 first selection is decided by a coin flip ** For the second meeting (for Group Ascend), Game 1 first selection is given to the opposing team ** Loser of previous game gets first selection for game 2-3 * '''Knights Rivals First Selection''' ** Teams in Group Ascend will get first selection rights for Game 1 ** Loser of previous game gets first selection for game 2-5 * '''Knockout Stage First Selection''' ** In Upper Bracket Quarterfinals, the top 4 in Group Ascend will get first selection rights for Game 1 ** For all remaining games, Game 1 first selection is decided by a coin flip ** Loser of previous game gets first selection for game 2-5 * '''Grand Final First Selection''' ** The Upper Bracket Final winner will get first ''map selection'' '''AND''' ''side selection'' rights for Game 1 ** Loser of previous game gets first selection for game 2-5

LPL/2026/Split 1.format:
* '''Regular Season''' (also known as ''Rumble Stage'') ** Teams are split into 3 groups based on overall LPL performance in 2025 *** Top 6 teams are placed into Group Ascend *** Next 4 teams are placed into Group Perseverance *** Bottom 4 teams are placed into Group Nirvana ** Teams will play a Double Round-Robin {{Abbr/Bo3}} within their groups ** In Group Ascend: *** Top 4 advance to Knockout Stage *** Bottom 2 advance to Knights Rivals Round 1 ** In Group Perseverance: *** Top 2 advance to Knights Rivals Round 1 *** Bottom 2 advance to Knights Rivals Round 2 ** In Group Nirvana: *** Top 2 advance to Knights Rivals Round 2 *** Bottom 2 is eliminated for the split ** Tiebreakers: **# Series Wins **# Game Difference **# Head-to-Head Series Wins **# Head-to-Head Game Difference **# {{Abbr/Bo3}} Tiebreaker Match, if it affects the team's advancement, seeding in Knights Rivals, or seeding in Knockout Stage * '''Knights Rivals''' ** Hybrid Elimination {{Abbr/Bo5}} ** 4 winners advance to Knockout Stage * '''Knockout Stage''' ** Double Elimination *** In order of position in Group Ascend, the 4 directly qualified teams will pick their opponents for Upper Bracket Quarterfinals *** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} * All matches uses {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}} * Top 2 teams qualify for [[First_Stand_Tournament/2026|First Stand 2026]]. * ''Click here for detailed information about First Selection''
* '''Regular Season First Selection''' ** During the first meeting between two teams, Game 1 first selection is decided at random ** For the second meeting, Game 1 first selection is given to the opposing team ** Loser of previous game gets first selection for game 2-3 * '''Knights Rivals First Selection''' ** The higher ranked team in Rumble Stage will get first selection rights for Game 1 *** Teams in Group Ascend is higher than Group Peserverance, and higher than Group Nirvana ** Loser of previous game gets first selection for game 2-5 * '''Knockout Stage First Selection''' ** In Upper Bracket Quarterfinals, the top 4 in Group Ascend will get first selection rights for Game 1 ** For all remaining games, Game 1 first selection is decided by a coin flip ** Loser of previous game gets first selection for game 2-5 * '''Grand Final First Selection''' ** The Upper Bracket Final winner will get first ''map selection'' '''AND''' ''side selection'' rights for Game 1 ** Loser of previous game gets first selection for game 2-5

LPL/2026/Regional Finals.format:
* '''Participants''' ** Up to four teams with highest [[LPL/2026/Championship_Points|Championship Points]] besides the [[LPL/2026/Split 3|LPL Split 3 2026 Champion]] (as the region's {{Ordinal|1}} seed) and the team with the highest Championship Points (as the region's {{Ordinal|2}} seed) will play. *** If two teams have the same points, the team with higher Split 3 points will be ranked higher. * '''Format''' ** Four teams compete in a Double Elimination format. *** Two teams with higher points begin in the Upper Bracket, the other two in the Lower Bracket. *** {{Bgcolortext|bg-proceed|Winner}} of the Upper Bracket qualifies for the [[World Championship/2026|World Championship]] as the region's {{Ordinal|3}} seed. *** {{Bgcolortext|bg-proceed|Winner}} of the Lower Bracket qualifies for the [[World Championship/2026|World Championship]] as the region's {{Ordinal|4}} seed. ** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}. ** ''Click here for bracket's information in different circumstances''
*'''If the region doesn't become MSI top 2 region:''' ** Three teams compete in a King of the Hill format. *** The team with the highest Championship Points begins in the Grand Final match. *** The other two teams play in Semi Final match. *** {{Bgcolortext|bg-proceed|Winner}} of the Grand final match qualifies for the [[World Championship/2026|World Championship]] as the region's {{Ordinal|3}} seed. *'''If the region's team wins MSI, qualify for Split 3 Playoffs but doesn't qualify for Worlds as region's 1st/2nd seed:''' ** Four teams compete in a King of the Hill format. *** MSI Champion begins in the Grand Final match. *** The team with the highest Championship Points begins in the Semi Final match. *** The other two teams play in Quarter Final match. *** {{Bgcolortext|bg-proceed|Winner}} of the Grand final match qualifies for the [[World Championship/2026|World Championship]] as the region's {{Ordinal|3}} seed. *** {{Bgcolortext|bg-down|Loser}} of the Grand final match qualifies for the [[World Championship/2026|World Championship]] as the region's {{Ordinal|4}} seed. *'''If the region's team wins MSI and qualify for Worlds as region's 1st/2nd seed''' or
'''If the region's team wins MSI but doesn't qualify for Split 3 Playoffs''' or
'''If the region is the MSI runner-up region''' (applied scenario)''':''' ** Four teams compete in a Double Elimination format. *** Two teams with higher points begin in the Upper Bracket, the other two in the Lower Bracket. *** {{Bgcolortext|bg-proceed|Winner}} of the Upper Bracket qualifies for the [[World Championship/2026|World Championship]] as the region's {{Ordinal|3}} seed. *** {{Bgcolortext|bg-proceed|Winner}} of the Lower Bracket qualifies for the [[World Championship/2026|World Championship]] as the region's {{Ordinal|4}} seed.

LPL/2026/Championship Points.format:
* The champion of Split 3 will automatically qualify for [[World_Championship/2026|World Championship 2026]] Main Event as the first seed.
* The team (other than the Split 3 champion) that has accrued the most championship points throughout the 2026 Season will qualify for [[World_Championship/2026|World Championship 2026]] Main Event as the second seed.
* The third and fourth seed, both determined at the [[LPL/2026/Regional_Finals|Regional Finals]], will also qualify for [[World_Championship/2026|World Championship 2026]] Main Event.
* If teams are tied by championship points, teams will be ranked based on Split 3 rankings.

** For the second meeting (for Group Ascend), Game 1 first selection is given to the opposing team
** Loser of previous game gets first selection for game 2-3

LCK/2026.format:
* '''Rounds 1-2''' - ''April 1<sup>st</sup> - May 31<sup>st</sup>, 2026''
** Double round-robin
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}} using {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}}
** {{bgcolortext|stayup|Top 6 teams}} qualify for [[/Road to MSI|Road to MSI]]
* '''Rounds 3-4''' - ''July 29<sup>th</sup> - August 23<sup>rd</sup>, 2026''
** 10 teams are split into two groups based on Round 1-2 standings
*** Top 5 teams from round 1-2 are assigned to '''Legend Group'''
*** Bottom 5 teams from round 1-2 are assigned to '''Rise Group'''
** Double round-robin
** Records from Rounds 1-2 are carried over.
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}} using {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}}
** {{bgcolortext|byeup|Top 2 teams}} from Legend Group advance to Playoffs Round 2
** {{bgcolortext|seedup|{{Ordinal|3-4}} teams}} from Legend Group advance to Playoffs Round 1
** {{bgcolortext|up|Bottom team}} from Legend Group and {{bgcolortext|up|top team}} from Rise Group advance to Play-In Round 1
** {{bgcolortext|stayup|2nd-3rd teams}} from Rise Group advance to Play-In Round 2
** {{bgcolortext|stay|Bottom two teams}} from Rise Group are eliminated
* '''Play-In''' - ''August 26<sup>th</sup> - 28<sup>th</sup>, 2026''
** Double Elimination
** Top two teams advance to Playoffs Round 1
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} using {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}}
* '''Playoffs''' - ''August 29<sup>th</sup> - September 13<sup>th</sup>, 2026''
** Double Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} using {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}}
** Top 3 teams qualify for [[World Championship/2026|Worlds]]
*** If [[Hanwha Life Esports]] (the MSI Champion) finishes in the top 3, then the {{Ordinal|4}} place team qualifies for Worlds as the {{Ordinal|4}} seed of LCK

LCK/2026/Cup.format:
* '''Group Battle''' - ''January 14 - February 1''
** 10 teams are split into two groups
** Each plays a single-round robin against teams from the opposite group
*** Teams from each group with the same seed face each other in Week 3 (the 'Super Week')
** All matches in Weeks 1 and 2 are {{Abbr/Bo3}} using {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}}
** Super Week matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} using {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}}
** Groups gain 1 point for every {{Abbr/Bo3}} win
** Groups gain 2 points for every {{Abbr/Bo5}} win
** The group with more points becomes the Winner Group and the other group becomes the Loser Group
*** {{bgcolortext|byeup|Top 2 teams from the Winner Group}} advance to Round 2 of playoffs
*** {{bgcolortext|seedup|Top team from the Loser Group}} advances to the Round 1 of playoffs
*** {{bgcolortext|stayup|Bottom 3 teams from the Winner Group}} and {{bgcolortext|stayup|middle 3 teams of the Loser Group}} advance to the Play-In Stage.
**** Among the teams advancing to the Play-In Stage, {{bgcolortext|up|2 teams with most wins}} receive byes into Play-In Round 2
*** {{bgcolortext|stay|Bottom team of the Loser Group}} is eliminated.
* '''Play-In''' - ''February 6 - 8''
** Double Elimination
* '''Playoffs''' - ''February 12 - March 1''
** Double Elimination
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} using {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}}
** Top two teams qualifiy for [[First Stand Tournament/2026|FST 2026]]

World Championship/2026.format: * '''Play-In''' - ''October 15th - 18th'' ** Four teams play in a Double Elimination bracket. ** Winner qualifies into Swiss Stage. ** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} using {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}}. ** {{Abbr/Right of First Selection}} for Game 1: **# Upper and Lower Bracket matches: Will be determined by Draw Order. **# Qualifying Match: Is replaced by {{Abbr/Right of Dual Selection}}; the winner of Upper Bracket Final will earn this. * '''Swiss Stage''' - ''October 23rd - 26th, 28th - 31st'' ** Sixteen teams play in a 5 round Swiss format. ** Teams that reach {{Bgcolortext|up|3 wins}} advance to Knockout Stage. ** Teams that reach {{Bgcolortext|down|3 losses}} are eliminated. ** Elimination and advancement matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}} using {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}}; all other matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}. ** {{Abbr/Right of First Selection}} for Game 1: **# Will be granted to the team with a higher regional seed. **# If both teams have the same regional seed, the Right will be determined by Draw Order. * '''Knockout Stage''' - ''November 3rd - 8th, November 14th'' ** Eight teams play in a Single Elimination bracket. ** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}} using {{Abbr/Fearless Draft}}. ** {{Abbr/Right of First Selection}} for Game 1: *** Quaterfinals: ***# Will be granted to the team with the better match record from the Swiss Stage. ***# If both teams have the same match record, the Right will be determined by Draw Order. *** Semifinals & Finals: Will be determined by coinflip. * '''Patch Information''' ** The tournament will be played on '''[[Patch 26.20]]'''.
